note: Actual curated grocery dataset: two provided reference photos and ten selected realistic synthetic grocery photos. The previous three clean preview images are excluded and removed. Assistant review notes are not independent human labels; expected stays null until formal labels are reviewed.
selection_status: included in the actual curated dataset at user request
annotation_policy: Generation prompts describe intentions, not rendered ground truth.
List only exposed food identities supported by the image; do not invent wholly hidden food.
Do not infer unlabelled produce masses, unreadable rear-pack contents or hidden egg counts.
A readable pack-total label can establish a count larger than the visible contents.
Different milk types and sizes stay separate evidence; do not multiply a single size across mixed packages.
Canned net contents do not imply drained contents. Rendered labels take precedence over planned sizes.
Single-meal/day/week labels describe the shopping-scene context, not verified nutritional sufficiency.
Synthetic retailer-style designs are not verified authentic SKU packaging or dated product availability.
school_model_test_status: Completed all 10 selected images; initial 9/10 success, then one successful separate recovery call.
